# nexspence_routing_rule (Resource)

A routing rule restricting which paths a repository may request. Attach it to a repository via routing_rule_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nexspence_routing_rule" "block_snapshots" {
  name        = "block-snapshots"
  description = "Deny any path containing -SNAPSHOT"
  mode        = "BLOCK"
  matchers    = [".*-SNAPSHOT.*"]
}

resource "nexspence_repository" "maven_group" {
  name            = "maven-all"
  format          = "maven2"
  type            = "group"
  routing_rule_id = nexspence_routing_rule.block_snapshots.id
  group {
    member_names = ["maven-releases", "maven-central"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `matchers` (List of String) Go regular expressions matched against the request path.
- `mode` (String) ALLOW (only matching paths pass) or BLOCK (matching paths are denied).
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
